name: capacitor-elec-6.3x7.7
description: SMD aluminium electrolytic, V-chip D6.3 x 7.7 mm. LCSC per value: 47u/50V = C72523 (Lelon RVT1H470M0607, 2000 h @ 105 C); 100u/50V = C3151829 (RVT1H101M0607)

esr.description: series resistance in ohms (RVT 47u/50V: ~3 ohm at 120 Hz, well under 1 ohm above 10 kHz)

lcsc.description: LCSC part number for this value

metadata.rotation_note: positive terminal is pad 1 at -x; the can's black bar sits over the NEGATIVE pad. Check JLCPCB's preview on the first order. LCSC lists the RVT series under ROQANG (Lelon-compatible V-chip size).
